projects.name: AdminisMine
projects.subtitle: Finance & operations system
projects.description: A full finance and operations platform that brings payables, receivables, payroll, production, permissions, reporting and an AI assistant into one auditable system.
projects.contribution: Built the finance, payroll, permissions, reporting and multilingual AI assistant modules described in the project documentation.
projects.problem: Finance and operational records spread across spreadsheets make balances hard to trust, permissions hard to govern and changes difficult to audit.
projects.solution: A modular web platform where financial balances are calculated from source records, every important action is auditable and sensitive changes are protected by granular permissions.
features: Payables, receivables, bank and cash workflows
Payroll, attendance and daily earned-pay records
Multi-currency records with exchange rates and reasons
Three-interface-language system with language-neutral stored records
Serbian, Turkish and English AI assistant
AI proposals use structured JSON, validation and explicit user confirmation
Audit log plus roles and granular permissions
technicalDetails: Balances are computed from payment and charge records instead of storing editable remaining amounts.
A shared polymorphic payments table connects invoices, rent charges, loans and bank movements.
Reads are cached and writes invalidate mounted resources so dashboard figures remain current.
The LLM can prepare a change, but cannot persist it without a human confirmation step.

projects.name: MnEcommerce
projects.subtitle: Mora Store
projects.description: A full-stack commerce MVP with a considered storefront, Laravel REST API, Filament administration and PostgreSQL transaction handling.
projects.contribution: Built the storefront, REST API, admin workflows and automated test coverage documented in the repository.
projects.problem: An online storefront must keep product, stock, cart and checkout state accurate while preventing duplicate orders and client-side price tampering.
projects.solution: A server-owned commerce model where prices and inventory are validated in PostgreSQL transactions, checkout retries are idempotent and the admin experience is separated from the customer storefront.
features: Product catalog with categories, search, sorting and variants
Persistent guest cart and customer authentication
Server-calculated prices, shipping and coupon discounts
Filament catalog, order, customer and supplier administration
Sitemap, metadata and responsive policy pages
technicalDetails: Monetary values use integer EUR cents to avoid floating-point errors.
PostgreSQL locking protects stock and coupon limits during checkout.
Browser and backend tests cover desktop, mobile, concurrency and recurring-order flows.
The API owns pricing and the storefront submits only product identifiers and quantities.

projects.name: EbookEcommerce
projects.subtitle: Digital book store
projects.description: A Laravel and React bookstore with catalog discovery, Stripe Checkout, secure digital delivery and an administration workflow for publishing books.
projects.contribution: Built the storefront, private library, Stripe checkout flow and admin dashboard described in the repository.
projects.problem: Digital commerce has to separate a pleasant browsing experience from strict access control around paid files and order state.
projects.solution: A server-rendered application where checkout prices come from the database and access to purchased files is granted only after a verified Stripe webhook.
features: Book detail pages with author and format details
Private customer library and guarded downloads
Admin book, order and revenue dashboard
technicalDetails: E-books live on a private disk and downloads stream through an ownership check.
Library access is granted by the verified checkout event rather than the success page.
Order items preserve the product price at purchase time.
Admin routes are protected by authentication and an admin gate.

projects.name: BatoDetailing
projects.subtitle: Detailing studio platform
projects.description: A Laravel and Alpine.js booking experience for a premium car-detailing studio, with customer accounts, role-based access and branded service presentation.
projects.contribution: Built the booking, account, loyalty, invoice and service presentation flows described in the repository.
projects.problem: A detailing studio needs bookings, customer communication and invoicing without losing the polished presentation of the brand.
projects.solution: A service-first website paired with a practical Laravel management layer for appointments, vehicles, invoices and role-based access.
features: Branded service catalog with transparent starting prices
technicalDetails: Appointment and service records use a normalized many-to-many relationship.
Policies and roles separate customer, staff and administrator capabilities.
PDF invoices are generated from appointment and pricing data.
The interface supports switching between English and Serbian.

projects.name: Crypto Market AI Report
projects.subtitle: Automated data & AI workflow
projects.description: A scheduled n8n workflow that combines two public market APIs, calculates explainable market signals and sends an AI-written daily report to Telegram.
projects.contribution: Built the workflow, data processing logic, AI analysis step and Telegram delivery flow documented in the repository.
projects.problem: A market summary has to transform a large, noisy API response into a compact set of signals that an AI model can reason about consistently.
projects.solution: A deterministic JavaScript preprocessing layer filters and scores roughly 2,000 assets before the AI agent writes a concise report grounded only in the prepared snapshot.
features: Parallel Fear & Greed and CoinPaprika requests
Around 2,000 records normalized into a compact snapshot
Market breadth, volume and stablecoin checks
technicalDetails: Liquidity thresholds remove low-cap and low-volume assets before ranking.
Wrapped, staked and stablecoin duplicates are excluded from the market view.
The prompt restricts the model to the supplied snapshot, improving factual grounding.
Long reports are split below Telegram's 4,096-character limit without breaking lines.
